blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Maharlika Investment Corp. (MIC) remains optimistic about Philippine investment opportunities, pledging to invest in projects that meet the country’s needs despite sluggish economic growth. During the first-ever ASEAN Sovereign Wealth Fund Forum, MIC President and CEO Rafael Consing Jr. stated that the weak economic growth did not affect the investment strategy of the sovereign wealth fund. “Our investments are not GDP growth-enabled. I look at our economy, and I see a K-curve. You have the top 5 percent generating significant wealth, and you’ve got the rest of the population suffering. My view is we need to help those […]...
